info.title: facturac Phase 3 external read integration
info.description: Disabled by default; server-to-server HTTPS Bearer credentials only. Credential identity, the operation-specific exact scope, immutable workspace/legal-entity/environment binding and current capability authorization are separate mandatory boundaries. Current verified/MFA-enabled owner/administrator sponsorship is revalidated on the primary database for each capability. Cookies never authenticate this adapter. No credential provisioning, recovery, writes, fiscal operations or AGT connections. GET/HEAD consume shared quotas: IP 120, integration 60, workspace 300 per minute. Production enablement requires subsequent Astra review and deployment gates. GET/HEAD accept no body inputs; authenticated nonempty bodies are rejected with 422. Empty JSON objects/arrays are tolerated but carry no input. Mandatory audit must be synchronously persisted before data or success is returned; disabled, buffered or cancelled audit fails closed. Additional independently grantable customers:read and catalogue:read scopes are production-context-only and share the existing integration/workspace quotas. External access stays disabled by default.

get.description: Production context only; homologation returns 403 before master queries. Explicit workspace/entity binding, fresh capability authority and durable audit required. GET/HEAD bodies with input rejected; HEAD performs the same authorization, queries, audit and quota consumption with no response body. No-store. Default active; page 1..10000, per_page 1..50. Literal case-sensitive Unicode substring, no accent folding; customers search name only, catalogue searches grouped name or code. Descending internal identity; offset pagination is not a cross-request snapshot. Unknown parameters rejected. Customer NIF/contact/address/commercial fields excluded. Catalogue base prices only; no stock/negotiated prices or tax certification. Shared fixed-window quotas across all resource families: IP 120/minute, integration 60/minute, workspace 300/minute, including denials and HEAD.

integrationBearer.description: The operation-specific exact scope must be granted on both credential and integration: documents:read for document operations, customers:read for customer operations, catalogue:read for catalogue operations. These grants are independent; no scope implies another. Current sponsor authorization and immutable explicit context are additionally required. Scopes are persisted server-side; caller scope strings grant nothing. Operation-specific grants are independent. documents:agt-status:read grants only the V2 status resource, never V1 access.

gross_total_minor.description: Integer minor units in currency_code; no cross-currency aggregate.

issue_status.description: Persisted fiscal status, including legacy status evidence; never rewritten by reads.

agt_status.description: Deprecated legacy workflow summary/provenance (SA1). Persisted submission value, or frozen legacy fallback only without a submission; no evidence-confidence or freshness assurance. Never use as fiscal or receipt authorization. Qualified operational status is internal and is not exposed by v1.
